acceptance: `evolve cli-health list --json` prints each benched family with benched_until (red: unknown command)
`evolve cli-health clear codex` removes the bench, so the next preflight reads the family as healthy
clear on a family that is not benched exits 1
fix: Add `evolve cli-health list [--json]`, which prints family, reason, evidence, benched_until and operator action from Store.Active. Add `evolve cli-health clear <family> [--reason T]`, which calls Store.Clear and appends an operator record like the canary's. Clearing a family that is not benched exits 1. Exit 2 on state I/O. Document both in runtime-reference.md's operator commands.
source: console, 2026-09-30, core-function CLI inventory (operator request: a CLI request for each core function)
summary: clihealth.Store records benched families (quota walls, boot strikes). Store.Clear (internal/clihealth/clihealth.go:230) is called only by the loop's launch canary (cli_health_canary.go:52,62). When a wall lifts early, which the operator can confirm with `evolve doctor live`, the family stays benched until the next launch's canary. No command shows which families are benched, why, or until when.
title: A benched CLI family can be inspected or lifted only by reading the cli-health state file or waiting for a launch's canary; add `evolve cli-health list|clear`
